notes: In agent mode the snapshot holds only players, so the camera player never appears as a world entity; third-person bodies would matter for the gui_inventory preview and any future spectate path. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): third person is off-profile; the first-person arm is ported. Formerly listed as missing: The third-person player body: no native player model, armor passes, held item or skin exist; the only player pixels drawn are the first-person arm and held item (raster_hand.c). Name-tag rendering for players and the sleeping rotation have no native counterpart. doRender's GUI use (GuiInventory.func_147046_a) is raster_mobs_player_preview: preRenderCallback's 0.9375, the y - yOffset translate, heldItemRight. lane/idxclient (later): the held block's renderItemIn3d branch (see RenderBiped) and the inventory preview through this renderer whole (GuiInventory).
